title: Public procurement open data: Portugal and Europe, 2026
description:
Measured public procurement data for 2026 (Portugal January to August, edition 2; Europe and the UK January to July), published by TRINTA (trinta.ai), a public tender intelligence company based in Lisbon.

  • Portugal: contracts, value and competition for every CPV code used (171,806 contracts reported to the Portal BASE, IMPIC, January to August, each contract counted once); public buyers by contracted value; each buyer's share of direct awards (ajuste direto).
  • Europe: the share of lots drawing a single bid in the EU Official Journal (TED), by country and by CPV division (571,148 lots, eForms BT-759).
  • United Kingdom: the same measure on the Find a Tender Service, by CPV division.

Methodology: https://trinta.ai/barometro and https://trinta.ai/single-bid-europe
